---
title: 'Not reported — Alternative aggregation rules with income control'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN)

data_majority <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_majority.parquet"))
data_all_months <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_all_months.parquet"))

data_majority <- data_majority |>
  mutate(income_per_capita_eur_time = income_per_capita_eur * time)
data_all_months <- data_all_months |>
  mutate(income_per_capita_eur_time = income_per_capita_eur * time)

controls_list <- "income_per_capita_eur_time"
```

## Majority rule (2 of 3 months)

### k = 1

```{r}
majority_k1_c <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df        = data_majority,
  outcome   = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group     = "id",
  time      = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects   = 1,
  placebo   = 1,
  controls  = controls_list
)
print(majority_k1_c)
```
